title: In season
description: A seasonal table of ordered levels by row and column, with absence, levels and unrecorded cells kept distinct.

props.name: data
props.description: { rowId, columnId, level } readings, at most one per declared row and column pair. level is an integer index into levels; null, an omitted pair or any other value means not recorded, drawn as a dashed outline rather than a level.

props.name: rows
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label } rows with unique nonempty IDs.

props.name: columns
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label } columns with unique nonempty IDs, labelled above the table.

props.name: levels
props.description: Two to five ordered level names, lowest first. The first level means absence and keeps an empty field; higher levels fill and outline more deeply.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned chart heading. Defaults to Levels.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; the table fades in once as a whole and honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; narrow containers scroll the table locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect cells through Recharts.
